as_told.title: Chrome-plated BB-like object spat out of nose, possibly an implant

plain: In 1964, a man named Richard Barth, a former guard at a nuclear missile site who says he was abducted by aliens, says he blew a small metal ball out of his nose. He tells it himself: he had a sinus problem and "a BB came out, little round ball with a flat side on it." A researcher on the same episode, not named, adds that it was not copper but looked "chrome plated or something". That researcher puts it years after Barth's childhood and suggests it was an implant. If so, it would be physical proof left behind by an abduction.
